help.text:
CaciaraBot watches the chat and occasionally reacts. Available commands:
/help - show this message
/status - show the bot's status in this chat
/sleep - pause the bot in this chat (admin only)
/wake - resume the bot in this chat (admin only)
/categories - show or change active categories (admin only to change)
/stats - show bot statistics
/reload - reload configuration (admin only)
permission.denied: This command is restricted to administrators.
